label: PowerEdge T350 tower server
description: Tower (4.5U-class) single-socket server with two embedded 1GbE LOM ports and a dedicated 1GbE iDRAC9 port. There is no OCP slot; networking beyond the LOM comes from two PCIe Gen4 and two PCIe Gen3 slots.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE LOM. No OCP bay at all - a 10GbE upgrade needs a PCIe stand-up card (2x Gen4 + 2x Gen3 slots). Dedicated iDRAC9 port on the rear.
